ops.title: PROVEN: native NAC (Corten nac-validation) works on host macOS 26.4.1 SIP-on
ops.body: Ran lrhodin/imessage `nac-validation` crate's test on the physical host (macOS 26.4.1 / build 25E253, SIP ENABLED). `generate_validation_data()` returned 517 bytes of valid NAC validation data. Confirms on the real Tahoe host: AAAbsintheContext resolves via dlopen from AppleAccount.framework; NAC selectors (NACInit/NACKeyEstablishment/NACSign) discovered by type-signature; runs SIP-ON with no injection/no SIP change; produces genuine validation data from the host's real IOKit identity. Both AppleAccount.framework + AOSKit.framework present. Toolchain (cargo/rustc/clang/xcrun) present on host. This clears Phase-0 GATE goals (1) framework+selector resolution on 26.x and (2) SIP-on operation. REMAINING gate = goal (3): does Apple ACCEPT a full IDS registration using this validation data (needs the throwaway Apple ID; watch for error 6001 fake-identity / 6005 re-login). Crate is MPL-2.0, self-contained (libc+thiserror+cc), exposes generate_validation_data() + step-wise NacContext{init,key_establishment,sign} for rustpush open-absinthe/native-nac integration. Supersedes the ban-vector pessimism about beeper/mac-registration-provider (that tool is offset-hijack + PAC-broken; this uses objc_msgSend class dispatch).
